exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Historical Silent Storm soft PAINTED diffuse COLOR effect source bitmap, faithful higher resolution shade; not new physical smoke/fire/object rendering.

Image1 is the EXACT ENTIRE native storedRGB source, solely whole NEAREST enlargement to512, made opaque to expose original color. Preserve COMPLETE edge-to-edge normalizedUV/field positions/shapes/count/phase/nativepaintscale/palette/relativeweak strengths. Keep original SOFT BLUR and smooth subdued painted shade. Final FULL ORIGINALalpha is restored independently and brightness only ONE global numeric scalar. No padding/crop/cutout/fitting. The nearest support visible sourcepixel sampling is only for exactUV: do not add squaredcells/grid/mosaic/granules or coarse mottledpaint. Render same gently blurred source tones, never make cells/stipples visible.

Native16x16 source is EXACTLY ONE compact softly blurred asymmetrical BEIGE/GOLD diffuse paint field on black, with ONE original broader brighter center at native[8,8] RGB214/190/120, dimmer upper-left lobe and lower-right soft extension. Keep EXACT native diagonal elongation/soft footprint, core size/position/shape, subdued beige/brown hierarchy and every verydim original perimeter pixel. It is not a white-hot fireball; do not whiten core or add new glowstrength, firetongues, rays, sparks, granules, curls, clouds, holes or fragments. Keep palette warm beige/gold, not orangeflame. Original nativealpha is0 across WHOLE canvas but RGB is useful visibleTransparentAdd source; no newalpha mask or opaque black border geometry.

Exact original wholeRGBA extrema are [[0, 214], [0, 190], [0, 120], [0, 0]]. Preserve actual dim sourcechannel maxima/relative localstrength, not manual255 or cosmeticcontrast. No newparticles/forms/rays/tongues/flecks/photonoise/paintgrain/hairfibers/raisedrims/highlights/whiteglints/text/symbols. Source is deliberately soft, no highpass/sharpenededges.

Output ONLY ENTIRE SAME opaqueRGB square canvas, identical wholeUV/no frame/whitespace/padding/recenter/crop/zoom/BBox/repacking/artistpatches. Entire originalsourceA/nativeType restored downstream, no sourcealpha or composition changes.
